_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

0a8e3e80bc0115c4.reason: REMOVED_PATH_RE's repeated group (?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)* starts each repetition with a literal '.', so there is one way to match and no catastrophic backtracking; its input is a removed-field path from the repository's own plan, not untrusted text.

34ce828308a77a9d.reason: git(): argv list, no shell, executable fixed to 'git'. Its arguments come from validate()-checked release trains (commit = HEX40, tag = TAGGED pattern of a VERSION-regex version, both fixed before any online call) and from repos.yaml URLs/branches and the constant WORKSPACE_URL, all reviewed files of this repository; CI runs it with contents: read and persist-credentials: false. No outside input reaches it.

697dc3cf38d63bda.reason: spec_check(): argv list, no shell, runs sys.executable on <workspace>/scripts/extract_spec.py with a mode from the SPEC_MODE table. The workspace tree is materialized only after Remote.on_branch() proves the train's 40-hex workspace commit is on upgrade/vault, i.e. reviewed code of this repository; env adds only the tree paths of the materialized components.

30edb075c03d64dd.reason: Unit-test helper: argv list, no shell, executable fixed to 'git', arguments are the test's own literals and temporary fixture paths (offline file:// repositories); no external input.
